assignment: Every unresolved ID appears exactly once; cross-batch consumer/dependency gates are explicit.
evidence_limit: Segmentation follows recorded live ownership and repaired deltas. It does not newly behaviorally reproduce all 57 findings.
package_acceptance_rule: A batch is a work allocation. Each Go package still has one complete atomic artifact inventory, integration decision and acceptance receipt even when several batches contribute.
validation_policy: Prepare the complete owner and dependency inventory before editing; do not pick the next isolated assertion as the batch boundary.
Implement all related producers, consumers, state transitions and removals in the selected coherent unit before final validation.
Capture a combined fail-before regression run; group multiple filters for the same Rust target in one invocation and group compatible crates in one Cargo command.
Run one combined post-change regression pass per target and the required integration/oracle gates. Recompile again only for a meaningful code change, failure or unresolved concern.
Run the required lint/all-target/publication build once at the completed batch boundary, then normal mandatory hook gates. Never bypass hooks.
Update both finding registers and living plans with actual evidence; partial fixes do not close parent findings or packages.
Keep all work local; no push or dry-run.

client-go internal/locate, internal/client and TiDB routing/MPP consumers

Delete the matrix interpreter only after all its callers use the shared executor. T01/K03 maintenance is evidence inside this batch, not acceptance of it.

batches.title: Schema, identity and timestamp protection
batches.completion_boundary: Versioned schema/upgrade, cluster identity/leases, cached-table leases and all active timestamp producers/reporters. Reporting precedes GC activation; GC also requires B04 durable delete-range work. Safe submilestones may proceed before the final cyclic integration gate.

batches.completion_boundary: Submit, schedule, execute, recover and wait on the same persisted job and schema lifecycle. Placement and delete ranges follow durable phases. Keep materialized-view/import seeds disabled until complete owners pass. B08 is required only for source modes that use DXF.

batches.completion_boundary: Physical fragment/task graph, replica/topology selection and configured compute cache/dispatch/recovery. Transport M04 is primarily tracked in B01; this batch supplies its final MPP consumer acceptance.

source_owners: TTL, resource/runaway, domain/crossks and DXF manager packages
batches.completion_boundary: Compose controller before RU history and DXF before dependent import/reorg work. Share startup gates, durable task state, transfer/recovery, cancellation and shutdown; keyspace holders must protect their own timestamps.

batches.completion_boundary: Real peers and SQL events feed owned providers, summaries, profiles/reports, replay archives and periodic learning/telemetry. Reuse process/session lifetimes and avoid synthetic rows or zero-field acceptance. Workload repository remains separate from learning. Dependencies gate relevant consumers, not every leaf prerequisite.
